cards.card_text: True or false: Moses says the LORD will afflict Israel again with the diseases they dreaded in Egypt.
cards.verse_text: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
cards.snippet: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they…

cards.card_text: Those who don't die are afflicted with tumors.
cards.verse_text: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
cards.snippet: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

cards.card_text: True or false: The priests and diviners point out that when God afflicted Egypt, the Egyptians sent the people out so they could go on their way.
cards.verse_text: When He afflicted them, did they not send the people out so they could go on their way?
cards.snippet: When He afflicted them, did they not send the people out so they could go…

cards.card_text: Then David tells Him, "You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty…"
cards.verse_text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
cards.snippet: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.

cards.card_text: Azariah says that back in those rough days, God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.
cards.verse_text: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.
cards.snippet: Nation was crushed by nation, and city by city, for God afflicted them with all kinds of adversity.

cards.card_text: After all this, Jehoram is afflicted with an incurable disease of the bowels, the very disease Elijah's letter named.
cards.verse_text: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
cards.snippet: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.

cards.card_text: Elihu says God doesn't keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted, and He never takes His eyes off the righteous.
cards.verse_text: He does not keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted.
cards.snippet: …does not keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted.

cards.card_text: He does not ___ the cry of the afflicted.
cards.verse_text: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
cards.snippet: …Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

cards.card_text: David says, "Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me!" and asks God to lift him up from the gates of death.
cards.verse_text: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me!
cards.snippet: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me!

cards.card_text: David says the LORD saves an afflicted people.
cards.verse_text: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
cards.snippet: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.

cards.card_text: What has the LORD done for the afflicted one?
cards.verse_text: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted.
cards.snippet: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted.

cards.card_text: He is lonely and afflicted His palace has been taken His crops have all failed
cards.verse_text: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
cards.snippet: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

cards.card_text: Next the prayer asks for the king to vindicate the afflicted among the people.
cards.verse_text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
cards.snippet: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and…

cards.card_text: The prayer says this king only helps the afflicted who already have someone on their side.
cards.verse_text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
cards.snippet: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

cards.card_text: His afflicted His priests His kings
cards.verse_text: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
cards.snippet: …of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.

cards.card_text: God also tells the assembly to uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
cards.verse_text: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
cards.snippet: …the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.

cards.card_text: He's been afflicted and near death.
cards.verse_text: From my youth I was afflicted and near death.
cards.snippet: From my youth I was afflicted and near death.

cards.card_text: How long has Heman been afflicted and near death?
cards.verse_text: From my youth I was afflicted and near death.
cards.snippet: From my youth I was afflicted and near death.

cards.card_text: afflicted blessed taught
cards.verse_text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
cards.snippet: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

cards.card_text: This prayer comes with a label on top: it's a prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.
cards.verse_text: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.
cards.snippet: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.

cards.card_text: His heart is afflicted, withered like grass.
cards.verse_text: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
cards.snippet: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.

cards.card_text: The afflicted man says he even forgets to ___ his bread.
cards.verse_text: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
cards.snippet: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.

cards.card_text: He says he believed, and so he said he was greatly afflicted.
cards.verse_text: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
cards.snippet: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

cards.card_text: Before he was afflicted, what does he say he did?
cards.verse_text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
cards.snippet: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.

cards.card_text: Why does the psalmist say it was good for him to be afflicted?
cards.verse_text: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
cards.snippet: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says the LORD afflicted him in faithfulness.
cards.verse_text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
cards.snippet: …LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.

cards.card_text: The psalmist says he is severely afflicted.
cards.verse_text: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
cards.snippet: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.

cards.card_text: And the LORD adorns the afflicted.
cards.verse_text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
cards.snippet: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

cards.card_text: True or false: the psalm says the LORD adorns the afflicted with riches.
cards.verse_text: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
cards.snippet: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

cards.card_text: Then the writer's next words stand up for the little guy: "Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate…"
cards.verse_text: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
cards.snippet: …a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,

cards.card_text: What will His afflicted people find there?
cards.verse_text: “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”
cards.snippet: “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”

cards.card_text: The passage ends with a promise: the LORD will show ___ to His afflicted ones.
cards.verse_text: For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
cards.snippet: …LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.

cards.card_text: Then the prophet says, 'Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.' Not with wine, friend, but with that cup from the LORD's hand.
cards.verse_text: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.
cards.snippet: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.

cards.card_text: Now watch how He takes it all: "He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth."
cards.verse_text: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth.
cards.snippet: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth.

cards.card_text: Now the LORD speaks to an afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace.
cards.verse_text: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
cards.snippet: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones…

cards.card_text: What does the LORD say He will build the afflicted city out of?
cards.verse_text: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
cards.snippet: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones…

cards.card_text: If they remove the yoke, give themselves to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, God says their light will go forth in the darkness.
cards.verse_text: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
cards.snippet: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your…

cards.card_text: In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them.
cards.verse_text: In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them.
cards.snippet: In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them.

cards.card_text: The prayer ends by asking whether the LORD will keep silent and afflict them beyond measure.
cards.verse_text: Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
cards.snippet: Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?

cards.card_text: And the LORD adds, 'even those whom I have afflicted.' Outcasts getting gathered up hits me RIGHT in the apron, friend, because I spent years in the back of a junk drawer.
cards.verse_text: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
cards.snippet: …the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.

cards.card_text: He tells Judah He will afflict them no longer.
cards.verse_text: Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
cards.snippet: Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, "Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you." ALL of them, friend, and nobody slips out the back door.
cards.verse_text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you.
cards.snippet: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you.

cards.card_text: afflicted strongest fattest
cards.verse_text: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, especially the afflicted of the flock.
cards.snippet: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, especially the afflicted of the flock.

cards.card_text: The afflicted of the flock who watch the staff called Favor get cut know it was the word of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
cards.snippet: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the…

cards.verse_text: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
cards.snippet: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it…

cards.card_text: Paul says being afflicted and being comforted both serve somebody's comfort.
cards.verse_text: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
cards.snippet: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it…

cards.card_text: Paul tells the Corinthians that when we are afflicted, it is for their comfort and their ___.
cards.verse_text: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
cards.snippet: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it…

cards.card_text: He says "it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you," and that's only half of it.
cards.verse_text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
cards.snippet: …it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

cards.card_text: Paul lists them: bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, bringing relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
cards.verse_text: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
cards.snippet: …entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
